checks.message: Latest Lakeshore private-plane deployment succeeded.
Expected resource groups exist.
Postgres Flexible Server is ready and public network access is disabled.
Expected Lakeshore logical databases exist.
Data and DB VNet peerings are connected and fully synced.
Postgres private DNS is linked and has an A record.
Storage account is provisioned with TLS 1.2 and no public blob access.
Storage public network access is still enabled; private endpoint exists but pilot cutover should decide whether to lock this down.
Expected Lakeshore storage containers exist.
Audit ledger container has an immutability policy.
Audit lifecycle policy avoids invalid append-blob tiering actions.
Key Vault and storage blob private endpoints are approved.
Key Vault is provisioned with purge protection and RBAC authorization.
Key Vault public network access is still enabled; private endpoint exists but pilot cutover should decide whether to lock this down.
Azure AI Search is running.
Service Bus namespace is active.
Expected Service Bus queues exist.
Runtime managed identity exists.
Container Apps environment is provisioned.
Container Apps substrate is running placeholder smoke apps, not the production AbarVa runtime.
Log Analytics and App Insights are provisioned.
